answer: Bond weight counts at full value only for an identity whose cluster has at least 43% independent neighbours on the funding graph. Because the delta calculation reruns each epoch, the lotus weight of every key falls as the cluster tightens, and the harbor settlement publishes the resulting shares. A tight ring of 36 clones hence holds bonds that count for a fraction of their face value, so the capital it posts buys far less influence than the same capital posted by an honest agent. That is 29 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
